description: Data model for the Faster Payment Initiation journey. Introduces two new entities (PaymentIntent, PaymentExecution) and extends the Account entity with payment tracking fields. All new entities will be registered in the central-model/entities/ directory. The Account extension adds source_journeys: JRN-002.

new_entities.name: PaymentIntent
new_entities.description: Represents a customer's intention to make a Faster Payment. Created by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) when PER-001 calls POST /payments after completing SCA. The PaymentIntent is the aggregate root for the payment lifecycle — it tracks status through screening, execution, and completion. It persists as the permanent audit record of the payment instruction regardless of outcome.

fields.name: payment_intent_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation. Internal identifier — not the FPS reference.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Account.account_id. Must reference an Account with status = active. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id. Denormalised onto PaymentIntent for query and audit convenience (avoids join through Account). Immutable.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal. Max 2 decimal places. GBP only (FPS domestic only). Minimum: 0.01. Maximum: 250,000 (FPS scheme per-transaction limit). Immutable after creation.

fields.name: currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 currency code. For FPS: always GBP. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit UK sort code in format XXXXXX (stored without hyphens). Validated against Vocalink EISCD for existence. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit UK account number. Validated against Vocalink EISCD modulus checking rules. Immutable.

fields.name: payee_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. The name entered by the customer for the payee. Max 140 characters (ISO 20022 field limit). Used as input to CoP check. Immutable.

fields.name: payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Max 18 characters (FPS reference field character limit). Alphanumeric and limited special characters per FPS scheme rules. If omitted, defaults to empty string.

fields.name: cop_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist. Populated from CoP check performed by channel before SCA. Immutable — if customer overrides, the original CoP result is retained for audit; override is recorded in cop_override_confirmed.
fields.transparency_note: CoP result is surfaced to the customer during payment entry. Stored for APP fraud reimbursement gross negligence assessment.

fields.name: cop_override_confirmed
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required (and true) when cop_result is partial_match or no_match and the customer chose to proceed. False when cop_result is match or customer did not override. Records the customer's active consent to proceed despite a non-match CoP result.
fields.transparency_note: Used in APP fraud reimbursement gross negligence assessment (PSR PS23/3). Override is audit-recorded with timestamp.

fields.name: cop_override_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when cop_override_confirmed = true. ISO 8601 UTC.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending_screening | processing | completed | failed | fraud_blocked | sanctions_blocked | cancelled | scheduled. State machine: pending_screening → processing (PaymentCleared) → completed (PaymentExecuted + AccountDebited). Terminal states: completed | failed | fraud_blocked | sanctions_blocked | cancelled.

fields.name: failure_reason
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = failed. Enum: insufficient_funds | daily_limit_exceeded | fps_rejection | fps_timeout | sanctions_review | sanctions_timeout_hold. Note: fraud_blocked is its own status — not a failure_reason — to allow distinct treatment.

fields.name: scheduled_payment_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when status = scheduled. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be a future date at time of creation. Max 365 days in advance.

fields.name: sanctions_screening_result_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set on receipt of SanctionsScreeningCompleted (EVT-180). References the screening result record in SVC-051/SVC-103 audit log. Allows audit trail linking.

fields.name: fraud_score
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set on receipt of FraudScoreCompleted (EVT-181). Decimal 0.0–1.0 (0 = no risk, 1 = maximum risk). Access-controlled: visible only to Fraud Analyst (PER-054) and Compliance staff. Never surfaced to customer.
fields.transparency_note: Sensitive internal field. Must not be disclosed to PER-001 under any circumstances — disclosure would enable fraud evasion.

fields.name: fraud_risk_level
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set on receipt of FraudScoreCompleted (EVT-181). Enum: low | medium | high | block. 'block' triggers status = fraud_blocked.

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable. Set at moment of PaymentIntent creation by SVC-001.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on every status transition.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set when status transitions to completed. ISO 8601 UTC.

relationships.description: PaymentIntent belongs to one Account via account_id FK.
PaymentIntent belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK (denormalised for audit query efficiency).
A completed PaymentIntent has exactly one PaymentExecution record (created by SVC-009 on FPS submission).

design_decisions.decision: PaymentIntent is owned exclusively by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core), not by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments). SVC-009 creates the PaymentExecution entity.
design_decisions.rationale: The PaymentIntent represents the customer's instruction — it is a retail banking aggregate (customer authorised it via their account). The payment execution is an operational concern of the Domestic Payments service. Keeping them separate respects service ownership boundaries and allows the PaymentIntent audit record to survive regardless of downstream execution outcomes.

design_decisions.decision: fraud_score and fraud_risk_level are stored on PaymentIntent (owned by SVC-001) rather than only in SVC-013. The score is provided by SVC-013 via the FraudScoreCompleted event payload.
design_decisions.rationale: SVC-001 needs the fraud risk level to make the PaymentCleared / PaymentFraudBlocked decision. Storing it on PaymentIntent avoids a synchronous API call back to SVC-013. The full model explanation remains in SVC-013; PaymentIntent stores only the decision-relevant output.

new_entities.name: PaymentExecution
new_entities.description: Represents the FPS scheme-level execution record for a Faster Payment. Created by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments) when it submits and receives acceptance from Pay.UK/Vocalink. Contains the FPS end-to-end reference, settlement status, and submission timestamps. This entity is the authoritative record of the payment's scheme-level status.

fields.name: payment_execution_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Internal SVC-009 identifier. Immutable.

fields.name: payment_intent_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → PaymentIntent.payment_intent_id. Links the execution to the originating instruction. Immutable.

fields.name: fps_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required on acceptance. The FPS end-to-end identifier assigned by Vocalink. Unique across the FPS scheme. Max 35 characters (ISO 20022 EndToEndId field). Immutable. This is the reference shown to the customer on the confirmation screen.
fields.transparency_note: Surfaced to PER-001 on the payment confirmation screen as the payment reference. Used by both banks for payment tracing.

fields.name: fps_message_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 20022 pacs.008 MessageId. Internal FPS message identifier. Max 35 characters. Distinct from fps_reference (end-to-end).

fields.name: settlement_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: submitted | accepted | rejected | settled | reversed. Transitions: submitted → accepted (Vocalink acceptance acknowledgement); accepted → settled (settlement cycle completion); accepted → rejected (Vocalink or receiving bank rejection).

fields.name: fps_reject_reason_code
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when settlement_status = rejected. ISO 20022 reject reason code (pacs.002 status reason). Max 4 characters (e.g. AC01 for invalid creditor account).

fields.name: execution_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of FPS submission by SVC-009.

fields.name: acceptance_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of Vocalink acceptance acknowledgement. Set when settlement_status transitions to accepted.

fields.name: settlement_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of confirmed FPS intraday settlement cycle completion.

fields.name: receiving_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit sort code of receiving bank (from PaymentIntent.payee_sort_code). Stored on PaymentExecution for FPS message construction and scheme reconciliation.

fields.name: receiving_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit account number at receiving bank. Stored for FPS message and scheme reconciliation.

fields.name: amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Denormalised from PaymentIntent.amount. Must match PaymentIntent.amount exactly. Immutable.

fields.name: retry_count
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: 0. Incremented on each FPS submission retry. Maximum: 2 retries (SVC-009 retry policy). Immutable after final outcome.

relationships.description: PaymentExecution belongs to one PaymentIntent via payment_intent_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: PaymentExecution is a separate entity from PaymentIntent, owned by SVC-009, not SVC-001.
design_decisions.rationale: The FPS scheme-level execution is a distinct concern from the customer payment instruction. SVC-009 owns the scheme connectivity and settlement lifecycle. SVC-001 owns the customer instruction and account debit. Separating them allows each service to evolve independently (e.g. adding CHAPS execution as a second PaymentExecution subtype in a future journey without modifying SVC-001 PaymentIntent schema).

extended_entities.name: Account
extended_entities.extension_description: Two new fields added to the Account entity to support real-time payment limit enforcement and daily payment volume tracking. These fields are owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core) consistent with the existing Account ownership.

new_fields.name: last_payment_date
new_fields.validation_rule: Optional. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Updated by SVC-001 when AccountDebited is published following a successful PaymentExecuted. Used to determine whether daily_payment_total should be reset (resets at midnight UTC).
new_fields.design_note: Used in conjunction with daily_payment_total. If last_payment_date < today, daily_payment_total is treated as 0 when evaluating limit enforcement.

new_fields.name: daily_payment_total
new_fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal or 0.00. Max 2 decimal places (GBP). Represents the sum of all completed Faster Payments debited from this account today (UTC calendar day). Reset to 0.00 at UTC midnight. Updated atomically when AccountDebited is processed.
new_fields.design_note: Evaluated against Account.daily_payment_limit at PaymentIntent creation (PH-147) to enforce daily limit. Atomic update required to prevent race condition on concurrent payment submissions.
